name: SSE consumer — Wikipedia recent-changes subscriber
notes: Connects to https://stream.wikimedia.org/v2/stream/recentchange via EventSource and emits parsed events to the filter. Handle reconnects.

name: Event filter + rate limiter
notes: Drops bots, non-enwiki, non-edit/new, trivial (<50 byte) diffs, and User:/Talk:/Wikipedia:/File:/Template: titles. Rate-limits kept events to 1 per 4s.

name: LLM narrator (Claude Haiku)
notes: Calls claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 with the Attenborough system prompt and the {user,title,comment,delta} payload. Returns one sentence, max 30 words, no quotation marks, never says 'Wikipedia'.

name: SSE server (Express /stream endpoint)
notes: Express/Fastify process that wires consumer → filter → narrator and re-broadcasts narrations to browser clients over SSE. Serves the static frontend too.

name: Frontend (vanilla JS, dark page, fading text)
notes: Single HTML page. EventSource consumer. Full-bleed dark background, large serif text, newest line fades in at top and older lines drift down/out. Tailwind via CDN OK. Pause-on-hover and copy-to-clipboard are polish.

name: TTS toggle (browser SpeechSynthesis)
notes: Toggle button that pipes each new narration through window.speechSynthesis with a slow, low-rate default voice. ElevenLabs is a stretch goal — out of MVP.

name: ElevenLabs TTS synth (server-side proxy + lazy cache)
notes: Server-side ElevenLabs proxy. /audio/:id route, in-memory LRU cache, daily char-cap kill-switch. Per decision 0007. SpeechSynth fallback preserved in public/tts.js.
